parsed.explanation: No visitor-facing restriction exists: no trans-specific offence, no facility or custody rule, no border friction documented, foreign documents accepted on ordinary terms. Rule of law is strong and operates FOR trans people — the Pride shooter received the maximum 30-year sentence, hate-crime statutes cover gender identity, and anti-discrimination machinery dates to 1981. Social climate is documented liberal, with hostility concentrated among extremist and organised anti-trans groups rather than diffuse. Negatives: rising hate-crime reports with falling clearance (52%→45%), heavy undercounting (only 8% report), and real targeted violence including a mass shooting — but the state response was maximally punitive, the security service reports declining threats, and violence rates sit near background levels, not a campaign. Care-access and resident-side gaps are climate signals only. Sits above the 0.85 anchor (functioning protection, isolated violence) but below 0.95 given the measurable rise in incidents and reporting distrust. ~0.88.
